text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower was injured during 
training, so we came to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for having made you worry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well then, now that you're patched up, 
let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Most likely... Ah, no! I'm really totally 
fine!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I feel like I shouldn't be 
resting over a minor injury like this... 
That's why...!"
choice_data_list:
Pushing yourself too hard isn't what makes 
you an adult.
Let's look for something we can do.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Let's go with the safer option.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. It'd be a real problem if 
the injury got worse.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll take the rest of the day 
off to rest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking disappointed, Nishino Flower 
headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Thank you very much! Well then, 
let's get going, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I run, there's this sharp, throbbing 
pain...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I said I'd be fine, but today, 
I just...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deciding that any more training would be 
impossible, I sent Nishino Flower back to 
the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! Trainer-san, as long 
as it's just light running, it doesn't 
hurt!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Training will probably be around this 
level for a while, so I look forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower spoke happily and took part 
in a light workout, making sure not to 
strain her injury.
